description.narrative: The project will improve the operational performance of the power sector and contribute to the Government of Bangladesh's target to achieve electricity for all by 2021 through (i) constructing (a) a 400/132-kilovolt (kV) substation at Gopalganj; (b) a 230 kV transmission line in the southern zone, from Barisal to Faridpur; and (c) a 400 kV transmission line in the western zone, from Bogra to Rohanpur; and (ii) implementing a capacity development program in the electric utility industry to promote socially and gender inclusive growth . The project will use state-of-the-art conductors with higher power transmission capacity and lower energy loss in both the 230 kV and 400 kV transmission lines.

title.narrative: Reports and Recommendations of the President
Reports and Recommendations of the President
Grant 0589: 100% of contracts awarded and 100% disbursed as of 07 Jul 2025
Grant 0590: 100% of contracts awarded and 92% disbursed as of 07 Jul 2025
Loan 3683: 87% of contracts awarded and 71% disbursed as of 07 Jul 2025

Progress Toward Outcome: Overall outcome of the project is as below-
1. Southern and western grid capacity power delivery capacity is 19,906 MVA (Baseline 2017-9000 MVA)
2. Transmission loss is 3.13%.
Some results are in the Audited Project Financial Statements | Feb 2025: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/51137/51137-001-apfs-en_5.pdf
Some results are in the Initial Environmental Examination | Oct 2021: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/51137/51137-001-iee-en_1.pdf
Some results are in the Resettlement Plans | Oct 2021: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/51137/51137-001-rp-en.pdf
Some results are in the Social Monitoring Reports | Feb 2025: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/51137/51137-001-smr-en_8.pdf

Status of Implementation Progress: A total of seven contracts were signed for this project. Out of the seven, already five contracts have been completed. Major achievements are - 1) Gopalganj (North) 400/132 kV substation with capacity of 3x325 MVA constructed, 2) New Bogra (West) substation with 400/230 kV, 2x750 MVA transformers constructed, 3) New Rohanpur substation with 400/132 kV, 2x325 MVA transformers constructed, 4) augmentation of Barishal and Faridpur substation completed, 5) Total 265 km transmission line constructed. Two contracts are ongoing. 1) construction of 230/33 kV 280 MVA substation at Charfassion area, Bhola and 1) 41 km 230 kV double circuit transmission line along with 175 km of reconductoring of existing line. Expected completion of the contracts is Dec 2025.
